scenario: Mixed-type interval construction per LINT.2.2 — both operands of `..` must be the same type, either both `Time` or both `Date`. Pin: `some_date .. some_time` rejects with DS_VALIDATE_INTERVAL_MIXED_OPERANDS.
rules_ds:
schema Window scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    when_d: Date mutable
    when_t: Time mutable

rule trig:
    Window w
->
    let bad = w.when_d .. w.when_t
    log info "x"
